name: Suryavanshi Spinning Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1978, Suryavanshi Spinning Mills Ltd manufactures cotton, blended yarns, and medical cotton.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SSML is engaged in the production of yarn and garments. It manufactures  Bleached Cotton for medical and Cosmetic applications. The company has also developed this product, suitable for Defence applications.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 257 to 128 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -46.7% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.58 Cr.
